personal.summary:
UX/UI Designer with 3+ years of experience designing
digital products and POS systems. Skilled in creating
intuitive interfaces for payment flows, dashboards, and
admin panels using Figma and modern UX methodologies.
Experienced in collaborating closely with developers and
leveraging front-end knowledge (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) to
ensure accurate implementation of UI designs. Conducted
design QA and validated user experience across real
devices, including POS terminals and self-service kiosks.
Strong understanding of transactional systems, product
onboarding, and real-world deployment environments.

experience.title: UX/UI Designer
experience.desc:
• Designed and improved user interfaces for POS systems
and digital products, including payment flows, dashboards,
and admin panels.
• Created wireframes, prototypes, and Ul components using
Figma and modern UX methodologies.
• Collaborated closely with developers to ensure accurate
implementation of UX/UI designs.
• Conducted design QA and usability testing to validate user
experience and interface behavior.
• Installed and configured POS software on Android-based
terminals such as Sunmi devices.
• Set up and tested self-order kiosks and hardwareintegrated systems before client deployment.
• Managed onboarding processes and prepared POs
systems for delivery to customers.
• Performed device testing to ensure seamless interaction
between software and integrated hardware (touch display,
printer, scanner).
• Managed POS and self-order kiosk setups on both
Android and Windows devices, including system
configuration and device testing.

experience.title: UX/UI Designer
experience.desc:
- Improved layouts to achieve usability and performance objectives.
- Documented style guidelines for high-traffic mobile apps.
- Collaborated with dev teams to ensure pixel-perfect implementation.

experience.title: UX Designer
experience.desc:
- Implemented Scrum methodology in software development cycles.
- Generated UX research and user flow concepts for media apps.
- Crafted icon sets and brand-aligned mobile interfaces.
